opportunity_ideas.industry_segment:
Industry: Financial services
Segment: SEA retail remittances
opportunity_ideas.problem_statement: Corridor settlement takes three days and correspondent fees compound at each hop. Operators cannot quote same-day without pre-funding balances they cannot afford.
opportunity_ideas.target_audience: Remittance operators (payer); senders and recipients (users); corridor banks (incumbent)
opportunity_ideas.technology_opportunity: Programmable settlement: value moves when the compliance condition clears, removing the human check that is itself the cost. Multi-party, low trust across corridor legs.
opportunity_ideas.name: Corridor (stablecoin settlement rail for SEA legs)

opportunity_ideas.industry_segment:
Industry: Agriculture
Segment: Coffee export provenance
opportunity_ideas.problem_statement: Buyers cannot verify origin claims; certifiers are paid by the producers they certify.
opportunity_ideas.technology_opportunity: Verifiable history, but the audit-log illusion applies: a human types the origin in. Real opportunity sits at the oracle, not the ledger.
opportunity_ideas.name: Terroir

opportunity_ideas.industry_segment:
Industry: Education
Segment: Vietnamese university credentials
opportunity_ideas.problem_statement: Employers cannot cheaply verify degrees; universities charge for each check and take weeks.
opportunity_ideas.technology_opportunity: Portable credentials across systems that will never share a database.
opportunity_ideas.name: Bằng

business_model_canvas.customer_segments: Mid-size regional banks and licensed remittance providers in SE Asia running cross-border USD settlement. Must-win: correspondent-banking cost owners.
business_model_canvas.value_propositions: Cost reduction and risk reduction: same-day cross-border settlement at a fraction of correspondent-banking fees, with pre-funded liquidity and onchain audit trail. Lead flavor: cost reduction.
business_model_canvas.channels: Awareness: fintech conferences, regulator sandboxes. Evaluation: pilot on a single corridor. Purchase: annual platform contract. Delivery: API + settlement dashboard. After-sales: dedicated integration engineer.
business_model_canvas.customer_relationships: Dedicated personal assistance during integration (high touch, costed as named SE per account); self-service dashboard thereafter.
business_model_canvas.revenue_streams: Usage fee per settled transaction (volume-dependent pricing) plus annual platform subscription. Willingness-to-pay benchmarked against current correspondent-banking spread: TBD, validate in pilot.
business_model_canvas.key_activities: Platform/network: operate the settlement rails and liquidity pools. Problem solving: corridor-specific compliance integration.
business_model_canvas.key_resources: Intellectual: settlement protocol and compliance tooling. Financial: pre-funded liquidity. Human: integration engineers.
business_model_canvas.key_partners: Licensed liquidity providers (acquire resource), local compliance/KYC vendors (acquire activity), custody partner (reduce risk).
business_model_canvas.cost_structure: Value-driven. Fixed: engineering, compliance, liquidity cost of capital. Variable: per-corridor onboarding. Watch: liquidity cost of capital is the dominant line.
